name: Latin Kings
aliases: Almighty Latin King and Queen Nation
description: The Almighty Latin King and Queen Nation (ALKQN) is one of the largest Hispanic street gangs in the United States, founded in 1954 in Chicago's Humboldt Park by Ramon Santos. A member of the People Nation alliance, the gang operates under two factions: the King Motherland Chicago (KMC), with an estimated 20,000–35,000 members across 31 states, and the New York Bloodline, founded by Luis Felipe in 1986, with an estimated 2,000–7,500 members across 5 states. Primary criminal activities include street-level distribution of cocaine, heroin, and marijuana.
